submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires on tokens that open a multi-token segment: the first BPE piece of a split word (rare proper nouns, technical adjectives and split identifiers such as Osc|orp, epigen|etic, metast|atic, hippocamp|al) and tab characters that open indented or continued code/comment spans. It stays near floor on complete single-token words even when rare (Osborne, Tesla, Apple), on continuation pieces (orp, etic, atic), and on punctuation, numbers and newlines.
